create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms structure with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by loading an entry from the adsorbate database using its integer ID
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up a SMILES string in the adsorbate database
create_adsorbate_random: create an Adsorbate object by randomly sampling an entry from the adsorbate database
rotate_adsorbate: rotate an adsorbate using random or heuristic mode and return the rotated atoms with rotation parameters
